mapping.draft_py:
# Rise of the Dark Realms: "Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under
# your control."
# M21 Liliana, Waker of the Dead's emblem ("put target creature card from a graveyard onto the
# battlefield under your control": MOVE_ZONE from Zone(GRAVEYARD, ANY) to Zone(BATTLEFIELD, YOU))
# with ALL creature cards (count QUnbounded, no choice) in place of the target.
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.SORCERY,
        effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QUnbounded(),
                mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        }),
    ),
]

clauses.clause: Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.

mapping.notes: M21 Liliana, Waker of the Dead's emblem move (Zone(GRAVEYARD, ANY) to Zone(BATTLEFIELD, YOU)) with ALL creature cards.
